title: Open Season and Qualifying Life Event Enrollment in TRICARE Prime
content:
A beneficiary who is not enrolled automatically may enroll in **TRICARE Prime** only during the open season or after a qualifying life event.

## Open season

The open season runs from the Monday of the second full week of November through the Monday of the second full week of December, and an open-season election takes effect on January 1 of the following plan year.

## Qualifying life events

Outside the open season, a Prime enrollment rests on a qualifying life event that DEERS has recorded for the beneficiary: marriage, birth or adoption, divorce, a move, a change in the sponsor's status, loss or gain of other health insurance, or death of the sponsor. The caller's own account of a life change is never a substitute for the DEERS record.

**Time condition.** The enrollment application must be received no later than the tier's qualifying-life-event enrollment window after the qualifying life event recorded in DEERS. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the DEERS event date, so the last timely day is the event date plus the window and an application received on that day is timely while one received the next day is not.

- The clock starts from the event date of the qualifying life event recorded in DEERS for the beneficiary, and the application relies on that DEERS life-event record.
- A qualifying-life-event enrollment takes effect on the DEERS event date, not on the application date.
- Each qualifying life event supports one enrollment change per family member.
- An application that misses the window is rejected, and the beneficiary may enroll at the next open season or after a new qualifying life event.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Qualifying-life-event window (calendar days) | Open season election allowed | Qualifying-life-event enrollment takes effect | Open-season election takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | 90 | no | on the date of the qualifying life event | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | 90 | no | on the date of the qualifying life event | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | 90 | yes | on the date of the qualifying life event | January 1 of the following plan year |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | 90 | yes | on the date of the qualifying life event | January 1 of the following plan year |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | 90 | yes | on the date of the qualifying life event | January 1 of the following plan year |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | 90 | yes | on the date of the qualifying life event | January 1 of the following plan year |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | 90 | yes | on the date of the qualifying life event | January 1 of the following plan year |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 90-day window)

| DEERS event date | Application received | Count of days after the event date | Timely |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 8 June | 90 (21 days to the end of March, 30 in April, 31 in May, 8 in June) | yes - the last timely day |
| 10 March | 9 June | 91 | no - rejected |
| 10 March | 10 March | 0 | yes |

In the timely cases the enrollment takes effect on 10 March, the DEERS event date, whatever day the application arrived.
